topic: Data discrepancy found in Japan analytics
summary_markdown:
A comparison of data between two datasets (alex_test_1 and vlad_test_2) was performed for a recent period, revealing a discrepancy in Japan across two facilities. The rest of the data matched. This issue is expected to be investigated and fixed on Monday.

Separately, it was confirmed that an update regarding the aggregation time interval for Rail in Finland has been deployed.
decisions: The data discrepancy found in Japan will be reviewed and addressed on Monday.
action_items: Review the data discrepancy with someone on Monday.
